design_rationale: The design balances clinical professionalism with spa-like warmth through a soft, nature-inspired palette and generous whitespace. Typography and spacing create a calming, unhurried experience while subtle accents and clean imagery build trust and approachability. Every visual element reinforces that dental care can be comfortable, welcoming, and even enjoyable.

sections.name: hero
sections.layout: Full-width hero with split composition: left-aligned text content (60%) and background imagery (40%). Content and image interact via subtle parallax on desktop.
sections.background: Gradient overlay from rgba(43, 138, 138, 0.15) to rgba(232, 180, 168, 0.1) over soft-focus dental office ambiance image (warm natural lighting, modern comfortable waiting area with plants and soothing colors)
sections.image_style: Warm, naturally-lit modern dental office interior or peaceful patient moment (smile, relaxation). Soft focus, natural color grading. Avoid clinical sterility; aim for spa-like serenity.
sections.text_position: left center, 5% margin from left edge
sections.cta_style: Primary button (see components) with arrow icon on the right, followed by secondary text link below; both have subtle hover animations

sections.name: hero_content
sections.headline: h1 text color #2C3E50, line height 1.2, letter spacing -0.02em
sections.subheading: h4 text color #6B7A88, weight 400, margin-top 1rem, max-width 480px
sections.buttons: Hero has two CTAs: primary 'Schedule Your Visit' (padding 1rem 2.5rem) and secondary 'Learn About Our Services' (border-bottom only, text-decoration underline on hover)

sections.name: services
sections.layout: 3-column grid on desktop, 2-column on tablet, 1-column on mobile. Equal-height cards with icon-text-link layout. Gap 2rem between cards and rows.

card_style.hover_effect: Shadow lifts to 0 12px 24px rgba(43, 138, 138, 0.12), border color shifts to #7BCCCF, transform translateY(-4px), transition 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)
card_style.icon_style: Circular 80px background using primary_light (#7BCCCF) with 20% opacity, centered SVG icon in primary (#2B8A8A), 40px size, rounded 50%

sections.card_content: h4 heading (1.375rem, 600 weight, #2C3E50), descriptive paragraph (1rem body text, #6B7A88, margin-top 1rem), 'Learn More' link with arrow (primary color, weight 600, hover underline)

sections.name: about_trust
sections.layout: Two-column layout (desktop): left column 45% image, right column 55% content with staggered list items. Tablet: stacked full-width. Mobile: stacked with image above text.
sections.image_section: Large rounded image (border-radius 20px, shadow 0 8px 32px rgba(43, 138, 138, 0.1)) of diverse family in dental office or dentist with patient, warm and trustworthy moment
sections.content_section: h2 heading, descriptive paragraph (body text, margin-bottom 2rem), followed by four trust markers displayed as a staggered list with left-aligned icons (40px circular backgrounds in accent color #E8B4A8 with 15% opacity, checkmark or relevant icon in primary_dark). Each list item 1rem spacing below previous, left padding 60px with icon positioned absolutely left of text.
trust_items: Experienced family dentistry team with 15+ years combined expertise
Gentle, anxiety-reducing techniques and modern pain management
State-of-the-art equipment for accurate, efficient care
Welcoming environment designed for patient comfort and relaxation

sections.name: treatments
sections.layout: Section heading centered (h2). Below: 4-column grid on desktop, 2-column on tablet, 1-column mobile. Cards simpler than services cards: just icon + label + brief description.

card_style.hover_effect: Background shifts to #E8F5F7, shadow to 0 4px 12px rgba(43, 138, 138, 0.1), no transform

sections.icon_style: 60px circular backgrounds in primary_light with 25% opacity, centered SVG in primary, 28px size

sections.name: testimonials
sections.layout: Section heading centered (h2), followed by 3-column grid on desktop, 2-column on tablet, 1-column mobile. Testimonial cards with quote, author, rating.

card_style.quote_style: Opening with 5-star rating (use ★ unicode, color #2B8A8A, margin-bottom 1rem), quotation marks or quotes element in accent color (#E8B4A8) at 3rem font size, letter-spacing 0.1em, positioned above body text
card_style.hover_effect: Subtle border color shift to primary_light (#7BCCCF), shadow to 0 6px 16px rgba(43, 138, 138, 0.08)

sections.quote_content: Italic testimonial body text (1rem, weight 400, #2C3E50, line-height 1.8, margin-bottom 1.5rem), author name (h4, 600 weight, #2C3E50), title (small text, #6B7A88, margin-top 0.5rem)

sections.name: cta_banner
sections.layout: Full-width banner section with vertical centering. Text left-aligned (60% width), large h2 heading in text_on_primary, body text below in text_on_primary at 80% opacity. Button on same row aligned right.
sections.background: Gradient from primary (#2B8A8A) at 0% to primary_dark (#1F5F5F) at 100%, angle 135deg. Subtle diagonal stripe pattern overlay (SVG or CSS repeating pattern, 30px diagonal stripes in rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03))
sections.button_style: Primary button with inverted colors: background white, text primary color, padding 1rem 2.5rem, hover background accent color (#E8B4A8), transition 200ms

sections.name: faq
sections.layout: Section heading centered (h2), followed by accordion layout. Single column, max-width 800px, centered. Each accordion item is a button row with chevron icon, expanding to reveal answer content.

sections.name: footer
sections.layout: 4-column grid on desktop (Services, About, Contact, Legal), 2-column on tablet, stacked on mobile. Footer top section has columns separated by 3rem. Below columns: divider line (1px solid #E1E8EB), then footer bottom with copyright text left-aligned and social icons right-aligned.
sections.link_style: Text links in text_on_primary (white) with opacity 85%, hover opacity 100%. No underline by default, underline on hover.
sections.column_content: small text size (0.875rem) in text_on_primary at 80% opacity, line-height 1.8, margin-bottom 0.75rem per list item
sections.social_icons: Circle backgrounds 40px, primary_light color at 20% opacity, SVG icons 20px in white, flex row gap 1rem, placed in footer-bottom right

mobile_adjustments: All h1 reduced from 3.5rem to 2.25rem, h2 from 2.75rem to 1.875rem, h3 from 2rem to 1.5rem for mobile readability
Section padding-y reduced from 5rem to 3rem on mobile, padding-x reduced from 2rem to 1.5rem
Hero section height reduced to 60vh on mobile
Services and treatments grid switches to 1 column below 768px
Testimonials grid switches to 1 column on mobile, 2 columns on tablet
Hero CTA buttons stack vertically (flex-direction column) and full-width below 768px
CTA banner text and button stack vertically with button full-width on mobile
Footer grid switches to 2-column on tablet, single column on mobile with centered text alignment
Card padding reduced from 2.5rem to 1.75rem on tablets, 1.5rem on mobile
Component gap reduced from 1.5rem to 1rem on mobile
Hero text max-width increases to 100% below 768px to utilize full available space
About section image hides on mobile (display none), text takes full width
